messages:
Anya: Heads-up: we've observed a recurring bench vs production quality gap for new models. Bench evals (golden prompts) pass but customer traffic shows hallucination spike. Thinking we need a replay-based sanity check in admit that uses sampled real queries, not just synthetic golds. Thoughts?
Siva: Strong +1 for replay sampling. Bench golds are biased. But replays raise privacy concerns and increase infra cost. We should only sample anonymized/consented traffic.
PJ: Maybe a hybrid: keep the golden suite for regressions and add a small "shadow-replay" run that replays a tiny traffic slice (1-5%) with obfuscation and lower retention. That gives signal without full cost.
Marcus: Also consider a confidence-band admit metric rather than a single pass/fail. E.g., require 95% of replay samples within tolerance. Then allow canary-serving with gradual ramp if band is borderline.
Anya: I like the confidence-band idea. Concretely: bench emits accuracy distribution over golden & replay. Admit gate rules: golden pass required; replay 95th percentile error < X or else require canary.
Siva: Implementation notes: replay runner should be a separate lightweight prober to avoid bench flakiness. It must run against the model binary in a hermetic way and produce per-sample metrics.
PJ: For privacy we can hash or strip PII and only keep aggregated metrics. Intake should require a customer privacy flag before we allow replay use for their traffic. Default: disabled.
Marcus: UX: Console should show distribution over both suites and a "canary recommended" call-to-action. Ops can opt into auto-canary for borderline models.
eval-bot: New check registered: REPLAY-01 "shadow-replay prober" (runs against intake-sliced traffic; aggregates lat/quality).
Anya: Action items:
- prototype replay prober (low QPS, local run mode)
- define admit confidence-band thresholds and canary escalation
- privacy guardrails + intake opt-in flag
- Console visualization for distributions + CTA
I'll write a short RFC with proposed thresholds. Ping me if you want to tweak metrics.
